translationRepairs: His uncle by marriage, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong, both valued him highly.

s0013 has 從叔司徒粲 and 征西將軍蔡興宗; 從叔 is a collateral paternal uncle, not an uncle by marriage, and 征西 is campaign-west, not pacify-west (安西/平西).
His uncle by marriage, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Pacifies the West Cai Xingzong, both held him in esteem.
His collateral paternal uncle, Minister Over the Masses Can, and his maternal uncle, General Who Campaigns West Cai Xingzong, both held him in esteem.
The same Chinese fixes apply to the literal: 從叔 is collateral paternal uncle and 征西將軍 is General Who Campaigns West, not Pacifies the West.
